integrity: Exact signed integral cellular complex, primitive generator, all 240 group actions; computational certificates complement the proof and do not establish independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Rational equivariant decomposition for the named ordered two-point configuration only; no new ordinary genus or Betti-rank claim and no integral equivariant lattice classification. Unindexed equivalent computation remains possible.
title: The full vertex-permutation and particle-exchange homology of two configurations on the Kuratowski graph
